items.name: Submodule.span_range_eq_iSup
items.type: {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] {ι : Sort u_6} {v : ι → M} : Submodule.span R (Set.range v) = ⨆ i, R ∙ v i

items.name: Submodule.span_singleton_eq_range
items.type: (R : Type u_1) {M : Type u_2} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] (y : M) : ↑(R ∙ y) = Set.range fun x => x • y

items.name: Submodule.span_range_update_add_smul

items.name: Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun
